[Macroeconomics · Nowcasting]{.eyebrow}

### Nowcasting Uzbekistan's Real GDP Growth

Monthly nowcasts of Uzbekistan's real GDP growth (production method), published as Uzstat's cumulative year-to-date figure with the discrete quarter beside it. Every change in the nowcast is explained by the data releases that caused it.

- **Method:** Monthly ingestion of indicator series into a vintage store with quality checks and alerts; transformations into model-ready y/y and seasonally adjusted panels; as-of reconstruction so the model can be evaluated against the information set available on any past date.
- **Pipeline:** Automated scheduled runs commit each vintage and the rebuilt panels to a dedicated data branch; change detection explains every revision.
- **Tools:** Python, pandas, GitHub Actions
- **Live now-cast:** [2026Q4 headline](https://mrshohruh.github.io/nowcasting/2026Q4/en/headline.html)

[View repository on GitHub](https://github.com/mrshohruh/nowcasting)
:::

[Econometrics · Monte Carlo Simulation]{.eyebrow}

### Evaluating the Confidence-Interval Performance of the Double LASSO Estimator

Finite-sample inference for Double LASSO in high-dimensional linear models.

- **Method:** Monte Carlo simulations across Gaussian, heavy-tailed, and approximately sparse data-generating processes, evaluating coverage, interval length, bias, and RMSE.
- **Findings:** Plug-in penalties deliver near-nominal coverage; heavy tails widen intervals; OLS becomes unstable as dimensionality approaches the sample size.
- **Tools:** Python, Quarto

[View repository on GitHub](https://github.com/mrshohruh/Double_Lasso)
:::

[Housing Economics · Agentic Reporting]{.eyebrow}

### Uyjoy — Quarterly Uzbek Housing & Rent Market Report

An agent that writes the quarterly Uzbek housing and rent market report (nationwide and Tashkent) in Uzbek, from raw olx.uz listings to a cited, numerically verified PDF.

- **Method:** Monthly olx.uz parquet exports are cleaned (duplicates, outliers, thin-cell flags, price caps) into a facts pack of medians, yields, an index and rankings for every region and Tashkent district; a listing-weighted change and a same-listings like-for-like check travel with every quarterly change so cleaning breaks never masquerade as market moves.
- **Pipeline:** Five sequential steps — build facts, collect cited news, write each section in Uzbek with Claude, validate every number against the facts pack and news markers, then render to HTML and PDF with hand-built SVG charts (national and district choropleths, dumbbells, heatmaps, iso-yield scatters).
- **Tools:** Python, pandas, Anthropic Claude API, Jinja, Playwright

[View repository on GitHub](https://github.com/mrshohruh/uyjoy-report)
:::
